trigger_condition: Two codemie sessions launch concurrently, or Claude reads hooks.json mid-rewrite
guard_snippet: const tmp = `${hooksFile}.${process.pid}.tmp`; await writeFile(tmp, json, 'utf-8'); await rename(tmp, hooksFile);
potential_consequence: Shared ~/.codemie/claude-plugin/hooks/hooks.json read truncated or empty; session starts without hooks

trigger_condition: process.execPath is per-shell or version-specific (fnm multishell dir, nvm/volta switch)
potential_consequence: Persisted node path vanishes when that shell closes; sessions with differing paths rewrite each other

trigger_condition: codemie run from npx cache, dev checkout, or a second install
potential_consequence: Shared hooks.json pinned to a transient or different CLI copy; later sessions run wrong or deleted script

trigger_condition: Non-win32 run finds exec-form file with Windows paths (shared or roaming home) and action is already_exists
guard_snippet: if (process.platform !== 'win32') { if (await hasExecFormEntries(hooksFile)) await this.restoreShellFormHooks(targetPath); return; }
potential_consequence: Windows node path stays in hooks.json; every hook fails until the plugin version bumps

trigger_condition: Installed Claude Code version predates hook `args` (exec form) support
potential_consequence: Hook runs bare node with no script; stdin payload executed as JS, hooks fail

trigger_condition: Installed hooks.json was hand-edited on Windows (timeout changed, entry added or removed)
guard_snippet: if (!codemieEntriesMatch(installed, expected)) { /* rewrite only codemie entries, keep the rest */ }
potential_consequence: Edits silently reverted on every launch; previously overwritten only on a version update

trigger_condition: codemie command carries quoted arguments, shell operators, redirections or variable expansion
potential_consequence: Quotes and operators become literal argv tokens; hook receives wrong arguments

trigger_condition: Converted entry already has an `args` key
potential_consequence: Existing args array silently replaced by script path plus split tokens

trigger_condition: nodePath or scriptPath is an extended-length path starting with \\?\
potential_consequence: Prefix becomes //?/ which Windows does not resolve; hook command not found

trigger_condition: A refreshInstalledHooks override rejects or throws synchronously
guard_snippet: try { await this.refreshInstalledHooks(targetPath); } catch (e) { logger.warn(`[${this.agentName}] hooks refresh failed: ${e}`); }
potential_consequence: Rejection reaches install's outer handler; successful copy reported failed, --plugin-dir not injected
